title: camfinder
description: Experimental SDR-assisted camera leakage detection for Cardputer Zero. Scans for weak electromagnetic leakage near crystal-clock harmonics, fits a shared offset model, and tracks persistent candidates. Practical detection relies heavily on an external low-noise amplifier (LNA): the original experiments used a 20 dB external LNA, and neither an Airspy Mini nor a USRP B210 captured the leakage effectively without one. The default package includes the Airspy backend; optional builds support SoapySDR.
